mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with lower S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased cost of capital and reduced liquidity in the financial system.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of the cases when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0% (over the entire data set).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 202.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of the cases when CPIAUCSL > 202.0 (over the entire data set).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.5%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signal an overheating economy that triggers a Fed response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of the cases when UNRATE < 4.5 AND INDPRO < 100 (over the entire data set).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising by more than 0.5 percentage points over the last 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened market volatility and risk-off sentiment.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5 percentage points over the last 3 months
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of the cases when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over the last 3 months (over the entire data set).

mechanism_narrative: A higher real GDP (GDPC1) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to stronger economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of the cases when GDPC1 is above the 50th percentile (over the entire data set).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1800.0 (thousands of units), it signals a weakening housing market that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of the cases when HOUST < 1800.0 (over the entire data set).

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer credit (RSAFS) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicates strong consumer demand and potential inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 0.5% in last month AND UNRATE < 4.5%
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of the cases when RSAFS growth > 0.5% in last month AND UNRATE < 4.5% (over the entire data set).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 202.0), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to the risk of a Fed rate hike to combat inflation.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of the cases when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 202.0 (over the entire data set).
